description: Set the task, struck the four down to two, and did not praise it.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Made the soap a quarrel about linen, and heard her name read back.
name: Joan Shakespeare

description: Corrected the field-name, and gave the white salt its peck.
name: Mary Shakespeare

description: Struck the second spelling of bushels.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Held the page, and left the shoe where it was.
name: William Shakespeare
